# Comparison

Compared `gmacsbase.TPL` from `devel_202610-3-00-01` (new, commit `26ad83eba24b937053941d9932bca4ea29f1c3dc`) with `devel_202610-46` (old, commit `5ce534f6d37a47e3b8d3f02a2b821e6768413c50`). The new branch is checked out in this workspace, so its line references link to the local source. Old-branch line references are recorded as `devel_202610-46:gmacsbase.TPL:L...`; that revision is not checked out as a workspace file.

The table includes identifier pairs whose declaration context and use indicate the same role. Run-control entries include several converged names: in the old version `StopAfterFnCall` and `usepinfile` cover both input values and command-line overrides that had separate names in the new revision. MSE-specific additions/removals and functions with no one-to-one counterpart are not reported as renames.

# Notes

The new branch includes MSE/data-generation functions (`InitializeData`, `GenerateData`, `ApplyMP`) and helper routines such as `predicted_catch_one_year` and `calc_predicted_comp_one` that are absent in branch 46. Conversely, `calc_relative_abundance` exists in both; branch 46's absence of the new per-row `calc_predicted_rel_abund_one` is a structural refactor, not counted as a one-to-one rename.
